The long, thin dark strips (possibly chives or decorative lines) have inconsistent thickness and seem to float or merge unnaturally with the plate and other ingredients. One strip seems to disappear into the white plate without casting a proper shadow.

In several areas, the dark sauce appears to blend seamlessly into the dark green leaves, making it difficult to distinguish where the leaf ends and the sauce begins. This suggests a failure in boundary separation.
